{{Top|leg}}
An '''identification pad''' was a type of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It incorporated a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] pad that could read an individual's thumbprint, and then return information on them by accessing background data, criminal records, or military history. The device's sensor pad was easily fooled by any type of oil or waxy residue smeared over a thumb, returning a inconclusive result. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] took advantage of the weakness by running their thumbs over their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], [[Ear/Legends|ears]], [[Nose/Legends|noses]] or [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] to pick up ear wax or grease residue to fool the sensor.<ref name="Domino Falls">{{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls|reprint=1}}</ref>
